title: fix(app-shell): Packages Scope badge reads the served writable verdict, so a marketplace install no longer reads Writable
body:
Fixes #12723
Clause-②: no

## What

Setup → Packages' Scope badge now takes writable vs. read-only from the server's `writable` field on each row (objectstack#14375), not from `scope`. Before, every row with no `scope` was badged "Writable". A marketplace install has no `scope` and the server serves `writable: false` for it, so it was badged Writable, and after #12675 it showed Source "Marketplace" beside Scope "Writable".

What each badge shows (`ScopeBadge` in `PackagesPage.tsx`):

| served `writable` | `scope` | badge |
|---|---|---|
| true | any | Writable |
| false | system | System |
| false | cloud | Cloud |
| false | project | Read-only · code |
| false | none | Read-only (new designer key `engine.packages.scope.readOnly`, en and zh) |
| absent | any | not drawn: the list already refuses the row at load (`PACKAGE_SOURCE_UNKNOWN`) |

The server's `isWritablePackage` decides which combinations exist: system/cloud are always false, a project DB base is true, and a project code package is false. So a project row the server marks writable now reads Writable instead of "Read-only · code".

Both places that draw the badge, the list row and the package detail sheet, now pass the whole row, so they cannot disagree.

## Tests

`PackagesPage.scopeWritable-12723.test.tsx` (5 tests):
- a scope-less marketplace install is Read-only beside Source marketplace;
- a scope-less authored base is Writable;
- system, cloud and project keep their badges;
- a row with no `writable` is refused at load and gets no badge;
- the detail sheet matches the list row.

Each was proven red by ablation of the line `if (writable) {`:
- adding `|| !pkg.manifest.scope` (the old defect): 3 tests fail;
- adding `&& scope !== 'project'`: 1 fails;
- adding `&& !!pkg.manifest.scope`: 1 fails.

After each, the restored blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

Local checks at head `8610471`, all exit 0:
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage`: 8 files, 65 tests;
- app-shell type-check, after the dependency build;
- check:i18n-keys, check:i18n-drift, check:i18n-dead-keys, check:i18n-designer-parity;
- changeset checks, test-path-roots, spec-symbols, new-line-citations;
- eslint on the changed files.

- Folding Scope into Source (the card's option 2) waits on objectstack#23972 and is not done here.
